name: personal-agent-aggregator
description: The reference stack for aggregating personal AI agents: one safe, storage-agnostic tracker for tasks, goals, projects, checkpoints, questions and approvals, over MCP, a CLI and signed webhooks.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test --experimental-sqlite tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:postgres: node scripts/require-env.mjs AGG_TEST_DATABASE_URL && npm run build && node --test --experimental-sqlite packages/core/tests/rls-postgres.test.mjs packages/server/tests/postgres.test.mjs tests/verify-rls-sql.test.mjs && AGG_TEST_DRIVER=postgres npm run test --workspace @agent-aggregator/core
